snippet.title: NOIRVANA - Official Trailer | Stand Still and You Die
snippet.description:
NOIRVANA is a high-speed noir FPS where standing still is just a polite way to get shot.

Slide through gunfire, dive past bullets, wall-run, wall-jump, and grapple across brutal black-and-white combat arenas. Chain your kills to build score and speed, stay aggressive to stay alive, and turn every room into a noir crime scene.

The only color is red. Try to make sure it isn't yours.

▶ WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4884670/NOIRVANA/

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⚡ FEATURES
- Fast, fluid movement — slide, dive, wall-run, grapple
- Score-attack arenas — chain kills, build combos, climb the leaderboard
- Aggressive combat — no cover camping, no breathing room
- Stylish black-and-white noir aesthetic with red as the only accent
- Special challenges: Headshots Only, No Damage, Time Limits

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎮 Developed by Ludus Noctis
